itinerary.title: Day 1: Rainbow Mountain ATV Tour
itinerary.body: Transportation · Entrance ticket · 1 rain poncho(weather is unpredictable, even in the dry season!) · 1 Hearty breakfast and hot drinks · 1 Delicious lunch · First Aid Kit/ Oxygen tank / basic medical supplies/ high altitude medication · Professional guide · Trained in high-altitude mountain rescue · ATVs (Honda TRX 250) Fuel · Helmet.
